info.name: Thrive Global Partner audio experiences API

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Values above 100 are clamped to 100, not rejected; `meta.pagination` reports the applied value.

params.name: locale
params.description: Locale, forwarded as the thrive-locale header

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of soundscapes — ambient audio tracks such as rainfall, ocean waves, and forest sounds that support focus, relaxation, and sleep. Each soundscape includes its playable audio, duration, imagery, captions where available, and tags.

params.name: locale
params.description: Locale, forwarded as the thrive-locale header

items.docs: Returns a single soundscape by its id, including its playable audio, duration, imagery, captions where available, and tags. Returns `404` when no soundscape exists for the id and `422` when the id is not a UUID.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Values above 100 are clamped to 100, not rejected; `meta.pagination` reports the applied value.

params.name: locale
params.description: Locale, forwarded as the thrive-locale header

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of bedtime stories — narrated audio stories that help listeners unwind and fall asleep. Each bedtime story includes its playable audio, duration, imagery, captions where available, and tags.

info.name: Get a bedtime story by id

params.name: locale
params.description: Locale, forwarded as the thrive-locale header

items.docs: Returns a single bedtime story by its id, including its playable audio, duration, imagery, captions where available, and tags. Returns `404` when no bedtime story exists for the id and `422` when the id is not a UUID.
